# komodo_builder (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo builder by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_builder" "default" {
  id = "default-builder" # ID or display name
}

# Use the builder ID when creating builds.
resource "komodo_build" "api" {
  name       = "api"
  builder_id = data.komodo_builder.default.id
  repo       = "myorg/api"
  branch     = "main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Builder ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `server_id` (String)
